name: Molten Brass Trap (CR 10)
body:
Molten Brass Trap
CR 10

XP 9,600
Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 29

EFFECTS

Trigger proximity; Reset automatic

Effect molten brass infused with negative energy rains from the ceiling (8d6 fire damage and 1 negative level per round, DC 15 Fort negates after 24 hours); DC 20 Reflex save for half fire damage and negate negative level; multiple targets (all targets in room); Onset Delay 1 round
